nodes.label: Next.js Breaking-Changes Agent Rule
nodes.source_location: # This is NOT the Next.js you know
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes vs training data; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code and heed deprecation notices.

nodes.label: Midnight Observatory Design Concept
nodes.rationale: Celestial navigation for markets: a private observatory of deep violet night, brass instruments, charted constellations of market data. Scene: an investor opens the site in the evening deciding whom to trust with family wealth — dark, calm, precise.

nodes.label: Color Strategy (Drenched Dark + Light Act + Violet Drench)
nodes.rationale: Drenched dark base + committed light act + one violet drench. Page arc: midnight (hero/ticker) -> porcelain (manifesto/products) -> midnight (journey/trust) -> porcelain (testimonials) -> violet (CTA) -> midnight (footer).
nodes.norm_label: color strategy (drenched dark + light act + violet drench)

nodes.label: OKLCH Color Tokens (Tailwind v4 @theme)
nodes.rationale: Tokens defined in src/app/globals.css: midnight, midnight-2, violet, violet-bright, lavender, lavender-dim, brass, brass-deep, porcelain, ink, ink-muted, mist. Dark is always violet midnight (never neutral black); brass capped at accent duty (<=10% of surface); lavender-dim keeps >=4.5:1 contrast on midnight.

nodes.label: Typography System (Fraunces + DM Sans)
nodes.rationale: Fraunces (variable: opsz, SOFT, WONK, italic) is the identity face because it matches the original logo wordmark; italic emphasizes exactly one word/phrase per heading. DM Sans for body/UI. Display ceiling clamp 6rem hero-only; letter-spacing floor -0.02em.

nodes.label: Motion System (Expo Ease + Lenis + Intro Gating)
nodes.rationale: Single ease --ease-out-expo cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1) (exported as EXPO from ui/Reveal); durations 0.2-0.3s micro, 0.8-1.25s reveals; Lenis smooth scroll; preloader gates hero choreography via IntroProvider context (useIntroDone); every animation has a reduced-motion path; marquee via animate-marquee keyframe with -50% translate and duplicated row.
nodes.norm_label: motion system (expo ease + lenis + intro gating)

nodes.label: landonorris.com Interaction Language
nodes.rationale: Borrowed patterns: drenched-brand preloader with monogram + counter, masked word reveals, marquee ticker, hover-sweep index rows, sticky scrollytelling, expo ease cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1).

nodes.label: Project-Specific Design Bans
nodes.rationale: No gradient text, backdrop-blur, side accent stripes, uppercase tracked eyebrows, emoji icons, or icon libraries (inline SVG only). Brass never exceeds accent duty on light sections (use brass-deep for text there, for contrast). Never neutral-black backgrounds — dark is always violet midnight.

nodes.label: Platizio Marketing Homepage
nodes.rationale: Complete redesign of platizio.com migrated from Astro to Next.js — same information, new visual identity. The page's single job: make a visitor feel Platizio is a precise, regulated, quietly confident navigator of markets — and book a consultation.

nodes.label: Brand Register (Design IS the Product)
nodes.rationale: Register is 'brand': design IS the product; a single-page storytelling site.

nodes.label: Target Audience (Indian Investors / HNIs)
nodes.rationale: Indian investors — working professionals and HNIs — evaluating whom to trust with family wealth; they value clarity, regulation, and discipline over hype.

nodes.label: Product Non-Negotiables
nodes.rationale: Fraunces is the identity typeface (matches existing logo wordmark), DM Sans body; AMFI/SEBI compliance copy and disclaimer verbatim from the original site; never invent statistics — the only stat is +24.8% YTD growth; scope is homepage only, other pages link to the live site.

nodes.label: Platizio Services LLP
nodes.rationale: Financial Products Distribution Platform; positioning 'Navigate every market with confidence'. Licensed/certified distributor of Mutual Funds and SIFs; AMFI ARN 341407; LLPIN AAQ-9558 (incorporated 5 Dec 2019); operates under SEBI framework; explicitly not a broker, adviser, portfolio manager, or research analyst.

nodes.label: Specialised Investment Funds (SIF)
nodes.rationale: SEBI-regulated vehicle with long-short, derivatives, and dynamic asset allocation in a mutual-fund-like framework; Equity/Debt/Hybrid strategy types; aimed at informed investors. SEBI SIF framework dated 27 February 2025. Use 'Specialised' spelling consistently.

nodes.label: Mutual Funds
nodes.rationale: Professionally managed pooled diversified portfolios; categories: Equity, Hybrid, Debt, Consumption-Focused, Thematic, Sectoral. Mandatory disclaimer: 'Mutual Fund investments are subject to market risks...'

nodes.label: Portfolio Management Services (PMS)
nodes.rationale: Direct-ownership personalized portfolios for HNIs under SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations 2020; SEBI-prescribed minimum investment Rs 50 lakh; discretionary vs non-discretionary formats.

nodes.label: Alternative Investment Funds (AIF)
nodes.rationale: SEBI-regulated pooled vehicles beyond conventional equity/debt (private equity, VC, structured credit, long-short) under SEBI (AIF) Regulations 2012; Categories I/II/III; Rs 1 crore minimum; liquidity trade-off with lock-ins.

nodes.label: International Investing
nodes.rationale: Global diversification outside India (US, Europe, China, emerging markets); currency risk is evaluated within overall portfolio risk; process: market selection, risk/allocation assessment, integration, periodic review.

nodes.label: AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India)
nodes.norm_label: amfi (association of mutual funds in india)

nodes.label: SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India)
nodes.norm_label: sebi (securities and exchange board of india)

nodes.label: Platizio Global (Global-Investing Service Layer)
nodes.rationale: Service/distribution/technology layer for eligible international products (U.S.-listed stocks, ETFs, fractional shares); Platizio does not execute orders, hold client funds, or custody securities; user is responsible for LRS/FEMA limits, tax and foreign-asset reporting.

nodes.label: ViewTrade (Execution Partner)
nodes.rationale: Handles order execution, settlement, and statements for Platizio Global international products.

nodes.label: Anuj Pal (Grievance Officer / Senior Financial Market Analyst)
nodes.rationale: Named as Operations and Compliance Officer/Head and Grievance Officer (grievances@platizio.com, +91 9289837100); also listed in the team as Senior Financial Market Analyst; grievances acknowledged within 24 hours, resolved within 15 business/working days.
nodes.norm_label: anuj pal (grievance officer / senior financial market analyst)

nodes.label: Book a Consultation Form
nodes.rationale: Fields: Full Name, Email, Phone (required); Product of Interest, Message (optional); submit label 'Submit Request'. Legacy Formspree endpoint is a placeholder — a real server action/CRM endpoint and privacy-consent review are needed. Calendar integration was 'coming soon' only.

nodes.label: Legal Pages (Privacy Policies + Terms)
nodes.rationale: Master privacy policy (DPDP Act, retention: KYC/AML >=8y, transactions >=10y, communications 5y, cookies <=24mo), master terms (Delhi law, Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996), plus separate global-investing privacy/terms. Legal wording must be carried across verbatim from the legacy source and reviewed by counsel before publishing.
